text_block_list.text:
While relaxing at home on my day off, a 
notification popped up on my phone: 
"Yamanin Zephyr's Day-Off Routine Stream"—
choice_data_list:
Sounds interesting... Maybe I'll take a 
look.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then, allow me to introduce my 
seasonal routine during my days off.”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, the start is on a mountain!? Isn't 
that way too hardcore!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a comment from Zephyr-chan's Trainer! 
Hope you enjoy the show♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, viewers. Make sure to sear 
the heroic figure of Chan-Mi into your 
memories.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We're deep in the mountains, after all. 
Let's be careful not to get separated as 
we move forward.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"First, everyone, please come this way. 
They say the spring water here is both 
safe and refreshing."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ahhh, so cold and delicious. It really 
hits the spot after hiking up the 
mountain.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Also, it's said that the deciduous figs 
and wild strawberries growing around here 
are sweet and beneficial for high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, so many comments! "Zephyr-san is 
such a walking encyclopedia~" it says♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, the wind tells me everything—where all 
the forest's bounties take root.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That spot is full of creeping figs, too. 
Right then, into Chan-chan's stomach you 
go~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Japanese wild figs are so yummy☆ 
Maybe I should take some home as a 
souvenir too~?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's see everyone's comments on 
the food report~... Huh? "Wait, isn't 
Zephyr-chan missing?" ...Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Indeed, I don't see them. We were 
together until just a moment ago, though.

text_block_list.name: Wild Animals
text_block_list.text:
(Snort snort... snicker!) (Eek, eek!) 
(Hoo-hoo)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A-Aren't some seriously dangerous things 
gathering here...!? Like, those cries, and 
those footsteps...!!
(Dum-dum-dum-dum-dummm~!)

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa-wa-wa~?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm back. Pardon me for stepping away. I 
was inviting a friendly breeze I'd like to 
introduce to you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san! ...And a bunch of animals!?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I invited them over to treat them to 
some Keifu.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Bush Warbler
text_block_list.text: (Hoo-hoke, hoo-hoke)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, please gather some shellfish 
for them. Hoke-san says they can't wait 
any longer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha, Kaiyose? So all I gotta do is 
give fruit to this bush warbler?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hoke-san becomes a whirlwind when it's 
mealtime. Please keep on dishing it out 
for him.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Mr. Striped. What flowery-scented nuts 
you have. Shall we trade for some wild 
strawberries, then...? Ufufu.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're feeding the squirrel! How 
nice~♪ You're great friends with them, 
Zephyr-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This may be a place where winds cross, but 
amid such abundance, there is no one 
harboring turbulent gusts.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The comments aren't slowing down at 
all...! Animal content truly is a force to 
be reckoned with.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you're interested in the natural 
wind patterns. What kind of expression 
would you like to see from it next?
choice_data_list:
"I want you to teach me more about the 
natural world!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you're interested in the natural 
wind patterns. What kind of expression 
would you like to see from it next?
choice_data_list:
"I want you to teach me more about the 
natural world!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"‘I'd love for you to teach me more about 
the natural world’... Yes, I would be 
delighted to share everything I know. Grow 
closer to it, and turn the spring tempest 
into a blessing."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I smell a viral opportunity. Let's turn 
this into a nature study session."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, what a refreshing breeze of an idea. I 
would be delighted to assist.

The stream trended on social media and 
viewership skyrocketed; Yamanin Zephyr 
looked thoroughly pleased!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"'What other animals are there?' ...Well, 
if we go just a little further, we might 
be able to invite Fluffy the Wild Hare."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"'What other animals are there?' ...Well, 
if we go just a little further, we might 
be able to invite Fluffy the Wild Hare."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, the comments section is going wild 
too♪ Let's go, let's go~☆

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To think a mountain hike could bring such 
a refreshing breeze. Fufu, streaming every 
once in a while is quite nice, isn't it?

Yamanin Zephyr interacting happily with 
the animals became a trending topic after 
that, and the video ranked #1 in monthly 
views!
